text:
alex: Need to provision a new GPU node pool in us-east4 for the embeddings/online-rerank workload. Target: A10G for cost balance, but want the option to fallback to h100-heavy pool if latency spikes.

alex: Requirements: ~100 concurrent small inference pods (each ~1 vCPU, 6GB RAM), model caching on node local SSD, pod density target = 8 pods/node. Autoscaling must be fast for p95 latency.

maria: Sounds good. Do we have quota for 100 A10Gs in us-east4? I think current used is high. I can open a quota request. @alex any preferred initial pool size?

alex: Start with min=4, max=30 nodes. We should use mixed preemptible/dedicated: try 70% preemptible to keep cost down but keep 2 dedicated for fallbacks. Node taints: gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule for dedicated nodes.

jia: +1 on mixed preemptible. Suggest using 1 A10G per node and n1-standard-32 (or equivalent N2 if perf test shows better throughput). Need drivers installed and cuda image pre-pulled. Also we should enable local-ssd for model cache: /mnt/model-cache.

sam: For cluster-autoscaler config, set --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m and --scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.5. Use expander=priority to prefer preemptible pool for scale-up. Also set node auto-provisioning off for this cluster (we want explicit pools).

alex: snip of the intended gcloud/Terraform snippet:
```
# gcloud example
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-us-east4-a10g \
  --cluster=inference-prod \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-32 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10g,count=1 \
  --disk-size=200GB \
  --local-ssd-count=1 \
  --num-nodes=4 \
  --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=4 --max-nodes=30 \
  --node-taints=gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule \
  --labels=pool=gpu-a10g,preemptible=true
```

maria: I'll file the quota ticket. Quick FYI: current quota for A10G vGPUs in us-east4 is 24 (we're at 20). Requesting increase to 200. Expect 24-72h for approvals. I'll CC finance for cost signoff. :+1:

quota-bot: GPU quota usage alert: us-east4 A10G quota at 83% (20/24). Ticket needed for provisioning >24.

jia: If quota takes >24h, can we temporarily provision in us-east1 where quota free? Network egress to customers primarily us-east4 so prefer same region but fallback possible. Also consider mixing a10g + a100 fractional to hit pod density targets if quota limited.

sam: Two operational items: 1) set node-ttl for scale-down to 15m to avoid churn on short bursts, 2) set PodPriority and Preemption policies so critical inference pods land on dedicated nodes when preemptions happen.

alex: Agreed. I'll add the following cluster-autoscaler flags in the node pool manifest/helm values:
```
clusterAutoscaler: 
  scaleDownUnneededTime: 10m
  scaleDownUnreadyTime: 20m
  expander: priority
  balanceSimilarNodeGroups: true
```

alex: Also we'll add a CronCheck job to validate driver presence and model cache mount on new nodes (run right after node join).

maria: Opening quota ticket now. Ticket: CLOUD-7890, requested A10G=200 in us-east4, justification: embeddings burst capacity for PLG. Attaching expected spend estimate.

infra-bot: terraform plan for module "gke_nodepool_gpu_a10g" finished with 2 changes. Waiting on PR review.

jia: For cost: projected baseline monthly if 30 nodes (mixed preemptible 70%) ~ $35k/month. We'll refine after perf tests.

alex: Action items: maria -> follow quota ticket and finance, sam -> idx autoscaler flags + podpriority, jia -> perf test nodes (n1 vs n2), alex -> open tf PR with taints/labels and model-cache init job.

sam: ACK. I'll also add alerts for GPU allocation per AZ and a runbook for preemption incidents.

alex: Thanks. If quota arrives earlier we can hit canary in 24h.

maria: noted. I'll post updates in this thread when quota changes.
